title: Wix App Audit
seo: Wix app audit and code review
meta: A prioritized review of your Wix app covering code, SDK use, speed and App Market rules, with an optional call. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Wix app audit that ranks what to fix first
overview: We review your app against what Wix expects: SDK and API use, permissions, dashboard and widget behavior, data handling, performance and the App Market guidelines. You send the repository and add us as a Dev Center collaborator. We return a written report ranking each finding by effort and impact, so your team knows what to fix first. Larger packages add a call and sample fixes.

pkgs.blurb: A written review of the biggest risks and quick wins.
A deeper review with widget speed tests and a 30 minute call.
A full review with a fix roadmap and a few sample fixes.

faq: Will you change my app during the audit?
No. The audit reads and reports only. The Premium package includes up to three sample fixes, which arrive as a separate pull request that you can accept or ignore.
Read access to the repository and a collaborator seat in your Dev Center. We do not need a site owner login or any passwords.
Does the audit cover App Market rules?

Yes, in the Standard and Premium packages. We check the points reviewers commonly raise, such as permissions, data use, pricing wording and install behavior, and tell you what to fix before you submit.
Can you fix the findings afterwards?
Yes. We can quote the fixes separately, or you can pass the report to your own developers. It is written so another developer can act on it without needing us.
